knowledge.content:
## Recall Pipeline

Recall pipeline BM25 matrum vector search-ai RRF moolam inaikkitradu. BM25 simple text search configuration payandugiradu — idu multilingual support-ku erpattadu, stemming illai. Vector search pgvector cosine similarity payandugiradu, minimum score threshold 0.35. AuthService matrum PaymentService irandume inda pipeline moolam recall seyyappadugindrana.

## Memory Types

Aindhu memory types ulladana: episodic, experiential, mental_model, decision, lesson.
